facts.prior_finding: Public and helper-facing recognition paths exposed only String results.
facts.current_finding: Whisper has resultRich and transcribeHypothesis paths, while compatibility transcribe and transcribeChunk still return String.
facts.follow_up: Adopt the rich contract at every provider-facing call site before selective repair.

facts.prior_finding: The command-line fallback passes -nt, so it has no timestamps.
facts.current_finding: The fallback still passes -nt. The owned helper can emit segment/token timing only through protocol v2 flags.
facts.follow_up: Keep command-line fallback conservative; use the rich helper path for timed repair experiments.

facts.prior_finding: The recognizer deleted WhisperAudioFile in a defer, preventing a verifier from sharing it.
facts.current_finding: preserveAudio can defer deletion across a caller-owned operation, but the default path still deletes after each recognition and no session-level audio lease exists.
facts.follow_up: Move canonical audio ownership to the session coordinator before verifier work.

facts.prior_finding: Parakeet collapsed FluidAudio output to text.
facts.current_finding: ParakeetRuntime.transcribe returns String and the wrapper creates a text-only RecognitionHypothesis; word timing/evidence is not retained.
facts.follow_up: Preserve provider-neutral Parakeet words, timing, and confidence before cross-engine fusion.

facts.prior_finding: Smart Decode retries the whole utterance with beam search when aggregate evidence is uncertain.
facts.current_finding: Adaptive decoding still retries the complete requested sample range; sample windows and timed metadata are available, but no uncertain-span planner exists.
facts.follow_up: Benchmark selective original-audio spans before introducing a larger verifier.

facts.prior_finding: Swift discarded aggregate helper evidence and retained only cleaned text.
facts.current_finding: Protocol v2 decodes timed words and aggregate fields into RecognitionHypothesis, but provider fallback paths and some fields still remain text-only or are not propagated end to end.
facts.follow_up: Verify every rich field survives the recognizer-to-coordinator path with focused fixtures.

facts.prior_finding: Decode While Speaking accumulated [String] chunks and joined them with spaces.
facts.current_finding: PredecodedTranscriptAccumulator still stores [String] and joins chunks with a space; it has no stable word identity or overlap reconciliation.
facts.follow_up: Replace chunk strings with bounded ordered rich state behind one coordinator.

facts.prior_finding: The architecture serializes recognition to preserve ordered delivery.
facts.current_finding: The actor-owned recognizer/helper session and existing predecode accumulator still provide one serial recognition/delivery chain; no coordinator-owned internal parallelism is present.
facts.follow_up: Keep one ordered delivery path while allowing bounded internal enhancement tasks.

facts.prior_finding: The 100-utterance LibriSpeech benchmark is insufficient for a universal sub-1% claim.
facts.current_finding: The repository still has the 100-utterance LibriSpeech smoke track and no consented application dictation corpus or full mode lifecycle harness.
facts.follow_up: Add the frozen application corpus and paired metrics before making any release accuracy claim.
